item.text: The compact evidence supports continuing the capacity-allocation question. The click-focused allocation gained 0.000156 AUC over its matched reference at the same parameter count, but inference was slower. Both smaller variants lost AUC and were also slower. These single-seed results leave the performance–cost question unresolved; I’ll record a continue decision.
